metadata.description: Sergii's agent skills: read-only investigation, special-case audits, review reports, tech writing. Plus pointers to upstream skill packs he uses.

plugins.name: investigate
plugins.description: Read-only investigation mode: answer, don't change. Includes a PreToolUse guard hook for Claude Code.

plugins.name: special-case-audit
plugins.description: Justify every new conditional/flag before it is written; drop branches that only defend your own earlier design.

plugins.name: review-report
plugins.description: Render code-review findings as an HTML table with severity, evidence, Jira ticket check and three fixes per finding.

plugins.name: linkedin-tech-posts
plugins.description: LinkedIn posts and Medium articles on AI/ML and software engineering for an engineering audience.

plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Upstream (Steph Ango, MIT): obsidian-markdown, obsidian-bases, obsidian-cli, json-canvas, defuddle.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Upstream (Matt Pocock, MIT): grill-me, grill-with-docs, write-a-skill, TDD, code review and more.
